tldr: Scopes URL query params by screen. A screen change keeps only namespace. Same-screen navigation keeps every param. The dashboard writes the namespace into the URL without a new history entry.
goal: 4 copies of param merging carry stale params between screens, and the namespace can be missing from the URL.

story.heading: Navigation keeps only the namespace across screens
story.body: A screen change keeps only namespace. Same-screen navigation keeps every param, so filters survive.

story.heading: Namespaces writes the URL without a history entry
story.body: The provider writes the resolved namespace with replaceState. It adds no history entry and does not reload the screen.

story.heading: URL param scoping requirements now implemented
story.body: All 8 requirements have code and tests. Namespace checks and link carry rules are covered.

story.heading: 4 param merges replaced by 1 helper
story.body: Links pass bare paths. buildScopedPath adds the params to keep, so each screen does not merge them.

components.summary: The session detail page sends Back to sessions through the scoped navigation hook.
Keeps only namespace on a screen change and every param on the same screen.
Derives the namespace during render and writes it into the URL with replaceState.

decisions.title: Allowlist the app-scoped params, not a denylist
decisions.why: Only namespace follows the user to other screens. New params stay on their screen unless the list names them.
decisions.alternative: Drop params that match a denylist

decisions.title: Scope by pathname, not by per-screen declaration
decisions.why: A link to the same path keeps every param. A link to another path keeps only namespace, so no screen declares its params.
decisions.alternative: Each screen declares the params it keeps

decisions.title: Write the namespace with replaceState, not router.replace
decisions.why: replaceState changes the URL without a navigation. The screen does not reload or add a history entry.
